Added CONFIG_SND_HDA_POWER_SAVE kconfig.  It's an experimental option
to achieve an aggressive power-saving.  With this option
will turn on/off the power of each codec and controller chip dynamically
on demand.
The patch introduces a new module option 'power_save'.  It specifies
the second of time-out for automatic power-down.  As default
10 seconds.  Setting 0 means to suppress the power-saving feature.
The codec may have analog-input loopbacks
by mixer elements such as 'Mic Playback Switch' or 'CD Playback Switch'.
When these are on
column2: we cannot turn off the mixer and the codec chip has

column1: to be kept on.  For bookkeeping these states
introduced.
For the bus-controller side
column2: a new callback pm_notify is introduced

column1: which can be used to turn on/off the contoller appropriately.
Note that this power-saving might cause slight click-noise at
power-on/off.  Also
column2: it might take some time to wake up the codec

column1: might even drop some tones at the very beginning.  This seems to be the
side-effect of turning off the controller chip.
This turn-off of the controller can be disabled by undefining
HDA_POWER_SAVE_RESET_CONTOLLER in hda_intel.c.
